_comment: Sam YT Shorts Engine — asset paths. Paths starting with '../' are RELATIVE to this brand_assets.json file (i.e. one level up = repo root). Override only if you've moved assets outside the repo.
_fonts_comment: Caption font used by burn_captions.py at 140pt. Montserrat is the OLD default Sam rejected — drop the new font files in ../fonts/ and point caption_black at the heaviest weight to swap.

cut._comment: Silence-strip + end-protection knobs (orchestrator CLI overrides win).

music._comment: Provider order auto = Suno -> ElevenLabs -> library. Set SUNO_API_KEY and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in env or the repo .env (see .env.example). No key -> falls through to the bundled library tracks. Music is RETIRED for Sam (music_enabled=false); this block only runs if you turn it back on.
